successCriteria.description: A new test in tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.routes.test.ts stubs getEmployeeProfileById to throw new NotFoundError('Employee not found') and asserts the injected GET /employees/me response has statusCode 404 and a JSON body matching { code: 'NOT_FOUND' }.
The new test builds the app with a valid authenticated actor (id + EmployeeRole.EMPLOYEE) so the 404 originates from the stubbed service throw, not from the resolveActor guard.
The test suite still passes (no existing employee route test regressed) and the new test fails if the route returns any status other than 404 or omits the NOT_FOUND code.

constraints: Import NotFoundError from '../../../../src/shared/errors' (the same relative depth the leave route test uses); do not re-declare or inline a local error class.

Reuse the existing buildApp helper and its employeeService decoration seam unchanged; only the getEmployeeProfileById stub behavior may throw. Do not alter the helper signature or the IEmployeeService stub shape.

Assert the response body with toMatchObject({ code: 'NOT_FOUND' }) (or an equivalent code-only assertion), matching the leave route test pattern; do not assert on the error message string as a hard requirement.
This is a test-only change: no production source, route, service, repository, or error class may be modified.
outOfScope: No production code changes: the route, service, repository, error classes, and app wiring remain untouched.
No changes to the existing buildApp helper, its service stub signature, or the existing 200/401 employee route tests.
No new test files or additional error-path coverage (e.g. 500 mapping, other AppError subclasses) beyond the single 404 case.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The 404 assertion must match the error contract emitted by sendError in src/modules/employee/employee.routes.ts: AppError -> reply.status(error.statusCode).send({ error, code }), so NotFoundError yields statusCode 404 and code 'NOT_FOUND'.
NotFoundError must carry statusCode 404 and code 'NOT_FOUND' as defined in the shared error contract; the test relies on these exact values.

The new test must follow the existing buildApp/decoration-seam and assertion style already established in the employee routes test file (actor decoration via preHandler, service stubbed at the employeeService decoration).
The 404 assertion pattern must mirror the leave route test's NotFoundError assertions (statusCode 404 + toMatchObject({ code: 'NOT_FOUND' })).
